raw_response: {"diagnosis": "About 60 customers in raw_customers have numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of names. The pipeline only applies upper(region), so the codes pass through to silver_customers and gold_region_daily. raw_region_map supplies a unique one-to-one mapping from these codes to region names, so a join on it fixes the values without changing the row set.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
